name: Smart Bulb Bridge (WiZ / Matter / Cync)
author: smoothsa
description: Drive individual WiZ, Matter and Cync RGB bulbs from FPP channel data.

privacy.summary: Sends the colors FPP is playing to the smart bulbs you configure (WiZ and Matter on your own network; Cync through Cync's cloud service if you set it up). Nothing is sent until you add bulbs.

sends.to: the WiZ bulbs at the local IP addresses you enter
sends.why: to light the bulbs from your sequence

sends.to: the Matter server running on this same device (port 5580)
sends.what: on/off, color and brightness commands for the Matter bulbs you enter
sends.why: to light the bulbs from your sequence

sends.to: Cync's cloud service (only if you set up Cync bulbs)
sends.what: your Cync account sign-in and on/off and RGB color commands
sends.why: Cync bulbs can only be controlled through their cloud account

collects.what: a log of start/stop messages and bulb send errors
your Cync email and password, if you set up Cync (never sent anywhere except Cync's sign-in)

systemChanges.what: runs a small background program as the FPP user while FPP is running; it listens only on this device (127.0.0.1)
adds one SmartBulbBridge entry to FPP's channel outputs when you save bulbs on the plugin page (FPP must be restarted to apply it)

privacy.other: The plugin compiles a small native channel-output library on this device when it is installed. Setting up Cync downloads the open-source pycync library with pip into the plugin's own folder. Matter bulbs need a separate Matter server, which this plugin does not install.
